A '''Rodian contact''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. A few months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] dispatched [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] to Mos Eisley to free a group of Rebel prisoners who were being held by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. When Renegade Squadron captured the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] the Rodian was in at the time, he offered to bring the Rebels to where they were holding the captives. He led the Renegades across the street&mdash;with the Rebels protecting him from the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] that was attacking&mdash;to a [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] that the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] were using as a temporary prison for their captives. Renegade Squadron then freed the prisoners and took them back to their base on [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]].
